title.value: Language Model Alignment with Elastic Reset
title.justification: The title is stated at the beginning of the paper and is used as the main reference throughout the document.
title.quote: Language Model Alignment with Elastic Reset

extractions.description: This paper addresses the challenge of optimizing language models through reinforcement learning (RL) without leading to 'language drift,' a common issue where models improve on specific rewards but degrade in performance on other tasks. The authors propose a new algorithm, Elastic Reset, which improves reward optimization while mitigating drift. Elastic Reset periodically resets the model to an exponential moving average (EMA) of itself which helps maintain improvements from pretraining. Experiments demonstrate that this technique achieves better balance between performance and reward optimization in tasks like translation and sentiment analysis.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on improving language model alignment in reinforcement learning contexts without direct mention or application in eco-responsible categories such as climate change or natural systems protection. It is more about optimizing AI training methodologies.
primary_category.quote: Finetuning language models with reinforcement learning (RL), e.g. from human feedback (HF), is a prominent method for alignment.

primary_sub_category.justification: As with the primary category, the sub-categories mainly cover eco-responsible topics which the paper does not directly address. The research is focused on AI training alignment rather than environmental or sustainable applications.
primary_sub_category.quote: The problems of drift, alignment tax, reward model overoptimization, and reward hacking are inherent to RLHF and reduce its efficacy.

applications.justification: The paper discusses the application of the Elastic Reset method in improving technical QA chatbots, indicating a practical use of their proposed technique.
applications.quote: Finally, we scale up even more to true RLHF finetuning of Llama-7B in order to create a helpful technical QA chatbot using a StackExchange dataset.

applications.justification: The method has been applied to improve sentiment analysis tasks, as seen in their experiments on the IMDB sentiment task with Elastic Reset.
applications.quote: we again show state-of-the-art performance on the benchmark. Through ablations, we show that Elastic Reset is robust to choices of hyperparameters, even more so than baselines.
